title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-19} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-3 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` equals `23719508/3`, which is strictly greater than `2^{19}*(319/100) = 41811968/25`.
- The next Taylor term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-19}`. This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below that majorant, hence strictly below `2^{-19}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is the case `C=1` on one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
